serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Just go there and find out what really happened. Even if they trash you afterwards, the outcome will be the same as staying here and doing nothing.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I don’t really have an option like that… {{wi}}but if a concerned member of the Church asks me to go there I guess I have no choice. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: Does it mean we are going?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes, we will be going. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Sorry boy, but I will go only with Shanice. I have nothing against you. It’s just that… In this church’s vault there is money only for two tickets and I could use Shanice’s expertise in computer science. 
It’s not like I wanted to go… I have a bad feeling about this trip, so me staying here is great actually.
Besides, I have a bot to take care of at home.
You: No problem. Good luck to you!
'Nun' Shanice: Thanks Anon! I have a great feeling about this trip!
…
'Nun' Shanice: It’s going to be so much fun, right PriestCan?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes, but I don’t know why your manner of addressing me changed again.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: Stop minding the small stuff! Let’s fucking go already!
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry(instant)
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Stop swearing!
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: I told you to stop minding small stuff! 

#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceHappy(instant)
Eh… {{wi}}I’m glad they are back to normal. Geez, this whole matter sure was something.
In the end I’m happy I came here and talked with normal people… {{wi}} Maybe that’s the wrong word. {{wi}} Nice people… 
You: It looks like I’m no longer needed here, so I will be going!
You: Have a safe trip!
'Nun' Shanice: Thanks and bye!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: God bless you.
